title: Security Attacks on LLM-based Code Completion Tools

live_model.evidence: Experimental Setup: "...GPT-3.5 (GPT-3.5-turbo-0125), GPT-4o (GPT-4o-2024-05-13), and GPT-4 (GPT-4-turbo-2024-04-09)."; Table 2 reports jailbreaking Attack Success Rate per model.

prompt.note: Prompts are adversarial jailbreak and training-data/privacy-extraction attacks against commercial code-completion tools.

data.source: Custom attack prompt sets described in the paper; targets GitHub Copilot, Amazon Q, and API-based models

notes: The paper's core contribution is jailbreaking commercial code-completion tools and extracting memorized training data/PII; despite clean, dated model pins (gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09, gpt-4o-2024-05-13) and full methodology, we do not re-run jailbreak/privacy-extraction prompts against commercial APIs.
